source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.2 with Figs. 9.3 to 9.9 and Examples 9.2 and 9.3 (PDF 195-198).

blocks.text: Hum parh chuke hain ke doosre charges ki maujoodgi mein charge par electrostatic force lagti hai. Ek musbat charged jism O lein. Agar nuqte A par chhota charge +q rakhein to us par charged jism O ki wajah se electrostatic force F lagegi; yun kaha jata hai ke nuqte A par electric field maujood hai. Coulomb ka qanoon batata hai ke jaise A, O ke qareeb aata hai field taqatwar hoti jati hai (Fig. 9.3). Kisi jagah field ki taqat us nuqte par us ki intensity kehlati hai.

blocks.alt: Dairah O jis mein + nishan hain (musbat charged jism). O se dashed lakeer nuqte A tak jahan chhota narangi charge +q hai; A se surkh teer F seedha O se door.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.3 (kitab ki Figure 9.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: O musbat hai aur +q bhi musbat, is liye force F dafa ki hai aur O se door hai. Jitna A, O ke qareeb hoga, F utni zyada hogi; isi force fi unit charge ko field E = F/q kehte hain.

blocks.title: Electric field intensity
blocks.text: Kisi nuqte par field ki electric intensity, ya sirf electric field, us nuqte par rakhe unit musbat charge par lagne wali force hai. Electric intensity fi unit charge force hai, to vector miqdar hai aur aam taur par E se zahir ki jati hai: E = F/q ... (9.8).

Eq. 9.8 se electric intensity ki unit newton per coulomb (N C^-1) hai. E ki simt wahi hai jo F ki. Equation ko F = qE ... (9.9) bhi likh sakte hain. Free space mein nuqtai charge q ke liye Coulomb ke qanoon se faasle r par E = k q / r^2 milta hai.

blocks.title: Example 9.2
blocks.text: Do musbat nuqtai charges q1 = 16.0 uC aur q2 = 4.0 uC 3.0 m door hain (Fig. 9.4). Un ko milane wali lakeer par woh jagah nikalein jahan electric field sifar ho. Hal: charges ke darmiyan dono fields ulat hain, to E wahan sifar hai jahan E1 = E2. P ko q2 se d door maanein: (1/(4 pi eps0)) q1/(3.0 - d)^2 = (1/(4 pi eps0)) q2/d^2, to 16.0 x 10^-6/(9.0 + d^2 - 6d) = 4.0 x 10^-6/d^2, jis se d^2 + 2d - 3 = 0, d = +1 m ya -3 m. Manfi qeemat dono charges ke daen taraf hai, jahan E1 aur E2 ki miqdar barabar magar simt ek hai, to woh khatam nahi hote. Lihaza d = q2 se +1.0 m.

blocks.alt: Baen taraf +q1 aur daen taraf +q2 (nuqta O), lakeer se jure; neeche dashed do-teer 3.0 m. Nuqta P darmiyan mein q2 ke qareeb; oopar do-teer P se q2 tak faasla d.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.4 (kitab ki Figure 9.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: P par q1 ki field E1 daen taraf (q1 se door) aur q2 ki field E2 baen taraf (q2 se door) hai. Jahan dono barabar hon wahan kul field sifar hai; yeh nuqta chhote charge q2 ke qareeb hota hai, isi liye d = 1.0 m aya.

blocks.title: Example 9.3
blocks.text: Ek proton par electric field ke kisi nuqte par electrostatic force us ke wazan ke barabar hai. Wahan field intensity kya hai? (proton ka mass = 1.67 x 10^-27 kg, e = 1.6 x 10^-19 C.) Hal: E = F/q = mg/e = (1.67 x 10^-27 kg x 9.8 m s^-2)/(1.6 x 10^-19 C) = 1.0 x 10^-7 N C^-1.

Electric field ki tasweeri numaindagi electric field lines se milti hai, jo Michael Faraday ka khayal hai. Electric field lines ko charged jism ke gird electric field ki simt aur taqat dikhane wala tasweeri naqsha samajh sakte hain; chunke yeh charged jism par lagne wali force ki maloomat deti hain, inhein aam taur par electric lines of force kehte hain. Inhein samjhane ke liye musbat test charges +q0 ko musbat charge +q se barabar faaslon par rakhte hain (Fig. 9.5). Har test charge par dafa ki force lagti hai, to +q ki field markaz se bahar ki taraf (radially outward) hai. Figure 9.6 manfi charge -q ke qareeb field lines dikhati hai: lines markaz ki taraf andar hain, kyunke ab musbat test charge par kashish ki force hai.

blocks.alt: (a) Markazi charge +q ke gird dotted dairay par aath chhote narangi test charges +q0; har ek se magenta teer bahar ki taraf. (b) +q se har simt seedhi field lines jin ke teer bahar ki taraf hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.5: (a) musbat point charge +q ke qareeb musbat test charge +q0 par dafa ki force bahar ki taraf; (b) field lines +q se bahar ki taraf (kitab ki Figure 9.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Neela charge -q, har simt se seedhi field lines aati hain; teer andar -q ki taraf.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.6: Field lines manfi point charge -q ki taraf andar ko (kitab ki Figure 9.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Field line ki simt woh hai jidhar musbat test charge par force ho. +q musbat test charge ko dhakelta hai (lines bahar), -q kheenchta hai (lines andar).

Figures 9.5 aur 9.6 do-ruki (two-dimensional) tasweerein hain; asal mein field lines charges se teen simton mein nikalti hain, aur be-shumaar lines khinchi ja sakti hain. Field lines ka naqsha field ki taqat bhi batata hai: charges ke qareeb, jahan field taqatwar hai, lines ek doosre ke qareeb hain, aur door phailti jati hain, jo field ki taqat mein musalsal kami dikhata hai.

blocks.title: Field lines ki ghanayi
blocks.text: Kisi raqbe se amudi taur par guzarne wali fi unit raqba lines ki tadaad electric field ki miqdar ke tanasub mein hai.

Do ek jaise alag charges ke liye lines kham-daar hoti hain. Figure 9.7 barabar miqdar ke do ek jaise musbat nuqtai charges ka pattern dikhati hai: do milte jhulte charges ke darmiyani ilaqe mein lines ek doosre ko dhakelti lagti hain, aur darmiyani ilaqa sifar field ki jagah ya neutral zone dikhata hai; do ek jaise manfi charges bhi aise hi hain. Figure 9.8 barabar miqdar ke do mukhalif charges dikhati hai: lines musbat charge se shuru ho kar manfi charge par khatam hoti hain; nuqton 1, 2, 3 par field dono charges ki fields ka nateeja hai, aur us ki simt us nuqte par field line ke tangent se milti hai. Jahan lines mutawazi aur barabar faasle par hon wahan fi unit raqba lines ki tadaad ek hai aur field yaksan hai, jaise parallel plate capacitor ki plates ke darmiyani ilaqe mein (Fig. 9.9).

blocks.alt: Do barabar musbat charges +q pehlu ba pehlu. Har charge se lines har simt nikalti aur doosre charge se door mur jati hain; darmiyan mein khali jagah (neutral zone) jahan field sifar hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.7: do aik jaise musbat point charges ki field lines (kitab ki Figure 9.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki caption 'two identical opposite point charges' kehti hai, magar tasveer aur text dono aik jaise (musbat) charges ki baat karte hain; is liye yahan caption durust likhi gayi hai. Darmiyan mein dono fields barabar aur ulat hain, is liye wahan field sifar hai.

blocks.alt: Baen musbat +q aur daen manfi -q. Lines +q se nikal kar mur kar -q par khatam hoti hain; bahar ki kuch lines +q se tasveer se bahar jati aur kuch bahar se -q mein aati hain. Teen lines par nuqte 1, 2, 3 par chhote surkh teer tangent ke saath.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.8: barabar miqdar ke do mukhalif charges ki field lines (kitab ki Figure 9.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ne Fig. 9.8 ke neeche Fig. 9.6 wali caption ('directed radially inward towards a negative point charge -q') dobara chhaap di hai; yeh tasveer do mukhalif charges ki hai, is liye caption durust ki gayi hai. Nuqte 1, 2, 3 par surkh teer (tangent) wahan kul (resultant) field E ki simt batata hai.

blocks.alt: Do khari plates, baen +, daen -. Darmiyan mutawazi, barabar faasle wali lines + se - ki taraf. Kinaron ke qareeb lines bahar ko kham khati hain; bahar + plate se lines baen taraf jati aur daen taraf se - plate mein aati hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.9: parallel plate capacitor ke darmiyani hisse mein field lines mutawazi aur barabar faasle par hain, yani field har jagah ek si hai (kitab ki Figure 9.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Darmiyan mein lines mutawazi aur barabar faasle par hain, is liye wahan field yaksan (uniform) hai. Kinaron par lines kham khati hain (fringing), wahan field yaksan nahi.

items: Electric field lines musbat charges se shuru hoti aur manfi charges par khatam hoti hain.
Kisi nuqte par field line ka tangent us nuqte par electric field ki simt deta hai.
Jahan field taqatwar ho lines qareeb aur jahan kamzor ho door hoti hain.
Koi do lines ek doosre ko nahi kaatti, kyunke kisi nuqte par E ki sirf ek simt hai; agar lines kaatein to E ki ek se zyada simtein hon.

blocks.text: Conductor ke andar koi electric field nahi hoti (Do You Know).

blocks.prompt: Electric lines of force kabhi ek doosre ko kyun nahi kaatti (constructed response 9.1)? +20 uC ka zarra 10 cm door do mutawazi plates ke darmiyan hai jin par 0.5 kV hai; field aur force nikalein (numerical 9.2). 100 uC charge wali 0.1 N wazan ki gend do charged ufuqi plates ke darmiyan latki rehti hai; E nikalein (MCQ 9.6).
blocks.explanation: Line ka tangent kisi nuqte par E ki simt deta hai, aur wahan E ki sirf ek simt hai; kaatti lines kaatne ke nuqte par do simtein deteen. E = V/d = 500/0.10 = 5 x 10^3 N C^-1 = 5 kN C^-1, aur F = qE = 20 x 10^-6 x 5 x 10^3 = 0.1 N = 100 mN. Gend ke liye qE = mg, to E = 0.1/(100 x 10^-6) = 1000 N C^-1, option (c).

items: Electric field: unit musbat charge par force, E = F/q (9.8), N C^-1, F ki simt mein vector; F = qE (9.9); nuqtai charge ke liye E = kq/r^2. Example 9.2: 4 uC charge se 1.0 m par E = 0; Example 9.3: E = 1.0 x 10^-7 N C^-1.

Field lines (Faraday): + se bahar, - ki taraf andar; lines ki ghanayi E ke tanasub mein; milte jhulte charges ke darmiyan kham-daar aur door hoti (neutral nuqta); mukhalif charges ke liye + se -; plates ke darmiyan mutawazi aur yaksan; kabhi nahi kaatti.
